annotations.title: Introduce new software (VVT entry and DPA review)

description: Prepares the data protection paperwork for introducing a new software or cloud service in the connected frag.hugo account. Step 1 (without `bestaetigung`): preview with the frag.hugo GDPR test result for the service (if reviewed), the matching template for the record of processing activities (Verarbeitungsverzeichnis) and what will be created, plus a confirmation value valid for 15 minutes. Step 2 (same input plus `bestaetigung`): creates a record of processing entry and a processor agreement (AVV) entry, both submitted for review by the data protection officer. It does not approve the software and does not contact the vendor.

bestaetigung.description: Value from the preview. Omit it to get the preview; send it unchanged to create the entries.

software.description: Name of the software or cloud service (e.g. "Slack", "HubSpot")

sprache.description: Output language. Default: German if the input is German, otherwise English.

vorlage_ref.description: Choose one of the templates offered in the preview (`vvt_vorlage.ref` or one of `weitere`) if the purpose fits better

zweck.description: What the software will be used for

name: plan_software_introduction

weitere.description: Other templates for the same product; pass one as `vorlage_ref` to use it
